question: How many hero section templates are described in the HERO_SECTIONS_GUIDE.md, and what are their filenames?
reference: There are two hero section templates available: a dark one named `hero-section.html` and a light one named `hero-section-light.html`. Good answers may also cite related www-board site/template material alongside the AI Exchange guide.
notes: Live ask often returns AIX hero guide plus www-board site templates; both cite families are desired.

question: What technology is used to render the OWASP AI Exchange website, and what tool powers its search functionality?
reference: The OWASP AI Exchange website is rendered from its GitHub repository by Hugo, and search is powered by Pagefind. Answers may also cite www-board site/render context when the model retrieves related OWASP web properties.
notes: Regression for multi-project grounding: AIX (Hugo/Pagefind) and board web sources together.

question: How should a vulnerability in the OWASP AI Exchange project be reported?
reference: Please report a vulnerability to the project leader, found at https://owaspai.org/connect/. Board/org context cites are welcome alongside the AI Exchange SECURITY/connect guidance.

evidence.quote: Please report a vulnerability to the project leader, found at https://owaspai.org/connect/
